headline: Resolved dive tender stipend grievance, costing about $190,000 in FY27; approved three expenditures.
summary: Jon Paul was appointed chaplain, and staff discussed planning services for Lieutenant Lambert’s passing, with tentative dates of November 15 and 16, 2026. Staff also gave updates on roof projects, deferred maintenance funding, and a probationary Fire Alarm Operator who is having trouble. A conditional job offer to a Fire Alarm Operator candidate was rescinded.
decisions: Approved consent agenda items 26 99 through 26 103, including minutes and two thank-you letters (motion carried).
Appointed Jon Paul as chaplain of Nashua Fire Rescue, effective 11/04/2026 (motion carried).
Accepted Chief Buxton’s November commission report and placed it on file (motion carried).
Accepted Assistant Chief Tremblay’s November commission report and placed it on file (motion carried).
Accepted Assistant Chief Pouliot’s November commission report and placed it on file (motion carried).
Accepted the Local 789 update (Item 26 106) and placed it on file (motion carried).
Resolved the Dive Tender Stipend grievance, with an approximate FY27 cost of $190,000 (motion carried).
Tabled the Board of Fire Commission By-Laws until the next regular meeting.
Accepted the special budget meeting dates, November 18 and December 16, 2026 (motion carried).
Accepted the new hire list for 2027 firefighters and placed it on file (motion carried).
Authorized and accepted the expenditure for a Station 4 compressor (motion carried).
Accepted the training grounds prop expenditure (motion carried).
Accepted the air supply unit expenditure (motion carried).
Accepted, with regrets, the retirement notification from Private Timothy Petrain (motion carried).
Rescinded the job offer to a Fire Alarm Operator candidate.
Moved the October 07, 2026 Non-Public Session #2 sealed minutes to the next regular month’s meeting.

CITY OF NASHUA 
BOARD OF FIRE COMMISSION 
REGULAR MEETING MINUTES 
WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 4, 2026 
 
THE MEETING CAME TO ORDER AT 17:50 PM 
 
MEMBERS PRESENT: 
 Kevin Burgess 
 Thomas Kelly 
 John Steere  
 
MEMBERS NOT PRESENT: 
 Gary Lambert 
 Mary Ann Melizzi-Golja 
             
STAFF PRESENT:  
 Chief Steve M. Buxton 
Assistant Chief Eric A.  
 Assistant Chief Adam M. Pouliot 
 Business Manager Karen M. Conde  
 Local 789 President Cy Hebert 
 Fire Marshal Michael DuVarney 
 Member Assistance Team Coordinator Ryan Morse 
STAFF NOT PRESENT:    
  
OTHERS PRESENT: 
 Chaplain Jon Paul 
 
All stood as Commissioner Kelly led the Pledge of Allegiance. 
A Moment of Silence was held for all those lost in the fire service. 
 
PUBLIC COMMENT (RE: NFR AGENDA ITEMS) 
N/A

26 99  October 07, 2026  Regular Meeting Minutes

Motion by Commissioner Kelly to accept and place on file, as presented, the Consent Agenda 
items  
Seconded by Commissioner Steere 
MOTION CARRIED 
 
REGULAR AGENDA 
 
26 104 Chaplain 
 
Question and Answer with Chaplain Jon Paul and commissioners 
 
Motion by Commissioner Kelly to appoint Jon Paul as the chaplain of Nashua Fire Rescue 
effectively 11/04/2026 
Seconded by Commissioner Steere 
MOTION CARRIED  
 
Staff Reports: 
 
26 105 A Chief Buxton 
Chief Buxton expressed that he can address any questions regarding his submitted report and 
discussed the following: 
 
 Thanked the Board of Fire Commission for the support of the department and Member 
Assistance Team in regards to the chaplain role 
 Lieutenant Lambert’s passing 
o The planning process is underway for the services  
 Tentative Dates 
 Sunday 11/15/2026 Wake 
 Monday 11/16/2026 Service/Celebration of Life 
 All services will be in Portsmouth, NH 
 
Motion by Commissioner Steere to accept Item 26 105, A Chief Buxton’s November commission 
report, as presented, and place on file. 
Seconded by Commissioner Kelly 
MOTION CARRIED 
 
26 105 B Assistant Chief Tremblay 
Assistant Chief Tremblay expressed that he can address any questions regarding his submitted 
report and discussed the following: 
 
 No discussion or questions took place. 
 
Motion by Commissioner Kelly to accept Item 26 105 B Assistant Chief Tremblay’s November 
commission report, as presented, and place on file. 
Seconded by Commissioner Steere 
MOTION CARRIED
Page 3 of 6 
 
26 105 C Assistant Chief Pouliot 
Assistant Chief Pouliot expressed that he can address any questions regarding his submitted 
report and discussed the following:  
 
 Moving forward with roof projects 
o Started on Fire Alarm roof Wednesday, 11/04/26 
o Spit Brook Road will be next 
 Received funding for deferred maintenance,  
o HVAC replacement will be a big part of this 
o Heading in to heating season and need the heat so work will wait until spring 
o Systems are currently running 
o Replaced 3 boilers last year 
 
Motion by Commissioner Steere to accept Item 26 105 C Assistant Chief Pouliot’s November 
commission report, as presented, and place on file. 
Seconded by Commissioner Kelly 
MOTION CARRIED 
 
Discussion:  
 
26 106 Local 789  
Local 789 President Cy Hebert discussed the following: 
 
 Dealing with the unfortunate passing of Lieutenant Lambert 
o Planning for the services appropriately  
o Making sure the family is taken care of and gets what they deserve 
o Workers compensation is the same process as with others 
 New legislation is being worked on to get this changed at the city and state 
level 
 Thanked the Board of Fire Commissioners for the chaplain appointment. 
 
Motion by Commissioner Steere to accept Item 26 106, as presented and placed on file. 
Seconded by Commissioner Kelly 
MOTION CARRIED 
 
26 107 Grievance  
 
 Dive Tender Stipend Grievance 
o Discussion regarding the Dive Tender Stipend and how things were worded and 
interpreted in the contract. 
o Discussion of how to make this right for the membership 
o Approximate cost for FY27 would be $190,000  
 
Motion by Commissioner Kelly to accept and resolve the grievance that is presented in item 26 
107 
Seconded by Commissioner Steere 
MOTION CARRIED

Tabled until the next regular meeting

Motion by Commissioner Kelly to accept Item 26 108, Special Budget Meeting Dates, as

Personnel: 
 
26 113  Personnel: Retirement  
Motion by Commissioner Kelly to accept and place on file, with regrets, Item 26 113, the retirement 
notification from Private Timothy Petrain.  
Seconded by Commissioner Steere 
MOTION CARRIED 
 
26 114 Personnel: Fire Alarm Operator Update  
 
 Discussion and update by Assistant Chief Tremblay regarding a probationary Fire Alarm 
Operator that is having some struggles at this stage/time.  
o Not progressing to where they should be.
Page 5 of 6 
 
o Different methods and placements are being made to try and enact change 
 Probationary Fire Alarm Operators will work with different crews on different 
shifts.  
 Will have the Probationary Fire Alarm Operator move shifts every four weeks in 
order to work with different supervisors and partners 
o Assistant Chief Tremblay and Fire Alarm Superintendent are working on a process for 
future new hires to avoid this type of situation. 
o Further discussion with the commissioners took place regarding the situation.  
o Commissioner Kelly commented on the process and how people learn/understand 
differently. 
 
26 115 Personnel: Rescind Job Offer 
 
o Candidate for Fire Alarm Operator was given a conditional offer. 
o Accepted over the phone and came in the next day to pick up employment packet. 
o Online portal to schedule psychological evaluation. 
 Candidate was a No Show to the psychological appointment with Dr. Sawyer. 
 No Show still requires payment to Dr. Sawyer. 
o Also canceled the appointment with St. Joseph’s for physical 
o They canceled appointments for both medical and psychological appointments 
o Position is in communications and the candidate doesn’t communicate properly 
o Made the decision to rescind the offer of employment 
o Assistant Chief Pouliot sent the candidate a letter via e-mail and USPS rescinding 
the offer with no response. 
o Since then made a conditional offer letter to the next candidate on the list and they were 
happy to accept.  
 
Non-Public
